page.layout: One page of text, verse dialogue in one column; running head at top; catchword "Ludicra" at lower right.

main_text.p:
Pericla fustinenda sint pastoribus,
Dum longa per deserta lanigeras oves
Ducunt, inaccessaque cautes (feruidus
Vbi stabulat leo & ferox Vrsus suos
Celat catulos,) dum nocte sublustri excubant,
Arcentque fures subdolos ovilibus.
main_text.head: Isacvs.
main_text.p:
Quid? me putatis insscio quoquam patre
Prodire velle quum Deus imperet bonis
Natos parentum vbique iussus obsequi
Patris verebor vsque iussa, nec licet
Me mandet ille pristinus mori, abnuam.
main_text.head: Pastores.
main_text.p:
Et te fouebunt vsque Cælites tuis
Si debitum honorem reddideris parentibus.
main_text.head: Isacvs:

p.i:
Adibo patrem meque cobiscum vt sinat
Migrare posscam: & dum reuertor, hic, precor,
Me paululum expectate. Past. Nos parebimus,
Melosque dum redis Deo cantabimus.

main_text.head: Chorus ex Pastoribus compositus.

p.i:
O, quam beatus, qui fugiens nefas,
Et legis almæ conscius, æthere
Celso parauit perfugium sibi:
Durisque fidens temporibus Deo,
Infantientum spes hominum procul
Cacas repellit, queque vagas solent

page.notes: Printed page is a single column of verse; the mark "Ludicra" at lower right is a catchword. Some line-ends are faint due to show-through and are read with [?] where uncertain: none marked here.
